title: Asset Health Overview
description: One goal opened as an arena (the Agent operations goal rings): its agents as dots seated in the section of the asset category their work is with, the held ones in front against the category's gate (white where calls get through, coloured for the share held up); behind the gate one cell per asset, problems lit with a beam; behind that the category's last 24 hours as a wall of bars when `day` is sent; the goal's progress as a ring in the middle. A label beside the arena reads each section. Drag to turn, scroll to zoom, shift-drag to pan, double-click to reset, click a section to pick it out. WebGL agents with a canvas fallback; SVG instruments in Lit.

title.description: Widget title. Defaults to name, then the goal's name.

goal.description: Agent counts are drawn as given and never recomputed. Alias: agents.

code.description: Shown under the title, e.g. G-007. Defaults to id.

total.description: Agents on the goal. Defaults to the states' sum.

working.description: Agents at work, not counting those over budget. Defaults to total less held and idle.

idle.description: Seated on the bench round the hub.

awaiting.description: Agents waiting on a person or a slow dependency.

overBudget.description: Agents at work past 80% of their token budget.

progress.description: Progress to target: 0.41, 41 or "41%". Omitted, the hub ring stays unlit and shows the agent total.

burn.description: Burn against baseline, shown in the hub's tip.

status.description: on track, at risk or blocked (and aliases). Omitted, no status is shown.

categories.description: One arena section per category, up to 12. Alias: data (WidgetItem rows).

unit.description: What its assets are called, plural: systems of record. Default assets.

total.description: Assets the goal works with here: one cell each. Defaults to healthy + degraded + failing, else what is listed.

healthy.description: The category's health overall, for its tip.

failing.description: Alias: failed_assets. Not bare failed (on a WidgetItem row that is the goal's failed agents).

items.description: Names of its assets, in cell order; assets in trouble may be among them.

state.description: blocked, failed, awaiting or slowed. Alias: sev. Free text maps: degrad / warn / slow / throttl / elevat → slowed; wait / pending → awaiting; impaired / error / down → failed.

agents.description: Agents of the goal it holds.

crew.description: The goal's agents whose work is with this category, the held among them. Defaults to the goal's working agents shared out by calls (else by assets).

held.description: Agents held here. Defaults to its problems' agents, else the goal's agents in that state shared among the sections holding in it.

hold.description: awaiting, blocked or failed. Defaults to the state of the problems holding most agents.

overBudget.description: Agents at work here past their budget. Defaults to the goal's, shared out like the working ones.

calls.description: Calls a minute the goal makes to it. Alias: cpm.

traffic.description: Shares of the traffic (fractions or counts) for the gate: flowing, throttled, awaiting, blocked, failed.

heldUp.description: Share of the traffic that does not get through, when no traffic mix is sent.

day.description: The goal's last 24 hours with the category, oldest first, in equal stretches (any number; 96 quarter-hours is typical). Omitted, the wall stands empty — nothing is invented.

agents.description: WidgetItem: the goal's agent total may sit on a category row.

failed.description: WidgetItem: the goal's failed agents — not failing assets.

data.description: WidgetItem category rows. Same item shape as categories; the goal's agent columns may sit on a row.

flat.description: Plan view: seen from straight overhead, without turning.

problemsOnly.description: Only problems stand out: agents at work all but go out, and sections where traffic flows step back.

showLegend.description: The legend button at the bottom left. Default true.

showTooltip.description: Tips on every mark. Default true.

theme.description: Stage appearance. Empty follows a local data-theme wrapper (not html), then paintMode / host --ui9000-*.
